documents.population: International Admissions I (neither the applicant nor the parents are Korean citizens), undergraduate, Spring 2027
documents.notes: '2027 Spring Undergraduate Admissions Guide for International Students' (online application 6-9 July 2026; original documents by post after preliminary admission, 16 October - 3 November 2026). The Fall 2027 guide is not yet published (the 2026 Fall guide is the previous one). Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): parents' nationality certificates, documents for single-parent / divorce / death cases, certificates of renunciation of Korean nationality, documents on online classes during COVID-19. Korean proficiency (TOPIK) is an alternative to English for the language requirement; admitted students may have to take a Korean proficiency test.

items.quote: Application Form ∙ Fill out on the online application website. ∙ Personal information (name, date of birth) must match those stated in all other documents.
Personal Statement and Study Plan ∙ Fill out on the online application website.
Recommendation Letter ∙ Only Submissions through the designated website are considered valid
Documents proving proficiency in Korean or English, including one or more of the following
items.condition: language proficiency shown with English scores (TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS Academic 6.0 / TEPS 269) rather than Korean scores or a Korean/English-medium curriculum

items.quote: Official High School Transcript ∙ Applicants who have not yet graduated must submit the latest transcript.
Official High School (Expected) Graduation Certificate ∙ Please highlight the (expected) graduation date.
After the preliminary admission decisions, these documents must be submitted by post with an Apostille or authentication by the Korean consular officer at the Embassy.
items.condition: preliminarily admitted applicants from high schools outside Korea (Apostille or Korean consular authentication)

items.quote: Submit a copy of an unexpired passport.
If nationality certificates or ID cards are not written in Korean or English, a notarized translation should also be submitted along with those documents.
items.condition: nationality certificate or ID card (used instead of a passport) not in Korean or English

items.quote: please upload your photo taken within the last six months.
